notes.title: The Gemini preset names gemini-2.5-flash, which is rerouted to a different model on 1 December 2026
notes.problem: The Google Gemini preset fills in gemini-2.5-flash. Google's deprecation page says that from December 1, 2026 all API requests to gemini-2.5-flash automatically route to gemini-3.5-flash-lite and are billed at Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite rates. The saved settings and the clip reason text (smart.py:292) keep naming the old model while another one answers.
notes.change: Change the preset's model to a model the provider still serves and, optionally, tell users who saved the old id in data/llm.json that it now routes to gemini-3.5-flash-lite.
notes.verify: Press Find models with a Gemini key and check that the preset's id is in the list the provider returns.

notes.title: A cut-off model answer is not detected, so a clip or a whole 15-minute window is silently left unread
notes.problem: _chat returns only the message content and the Ollama branch only 'response' (llm.py:196); no finish reason is read. Caps are small (judge 420 at smart.py:105, heading 180, whole-talk 120+90*n at wholepass.py:75). A reply cut at the cap is a successful call, so nothing is resent; the cut JSON makes parse_json raise and the caller swallows it: wholepass.py:80-81 does `continue` and drops that window's picks, smart.py:294 only appends '(skipped reading ...)'. Open PR #82 raises only the connection test's budget (30 to 512) for models that spend it on reasoning.
notes.change: Read choices[0].finish_reason in _chat (and the done signal on the Ollama branch if the project wants it) and raise a specific error on 'length'. Have cloud_complete resend once with a larger budget on that error (a different request, so not an unchanged retry), and report a skipped window in wholepass.proposals instead of continuing silently.
notes.verify: Call cloud_complete with budget=5 against a stub that answers finish_reason 'length' and check that it raises or resends with a larger max_tokens; then run a whole-talk pass with the stub failing one window and check that the progress report names the skipped window.

notes.title: The edit planner sends up to 45,000 characters to a local Ollama model with no num_ctx
notes.problem: The planner builds one prompt of up to 45,000 characters (studio_plans.py:170; about 11,000 tokens at 4 characters per token, an estimate) and sends it through smart._payload, which sets only temperature and num_predict; no file sets num_ctx. Ollama's context-length page gives 4k context below 24 GiB VRAM, 32k for 24-48 GiB, 256k from 48 GiB. The page does not say what happens to an overflow. wholepass.py:15 records Ollama answering HTTP 500 on 15-minute windows and shrinks them to 5 minutes locally; the planner has no such local limit.
notes.change: For a local model, either send options.num_ctx sized to the prompt (and fall back to a smaller source range when it does not fit), or lower the 45,000-character guard when the model is not a cloud model, as wholepass.py does with LOCAL_WINDOW.
notes.verify: On a machine with under 24 GiB VRAM, plan a 45,000-character range in 'topic' mode, then read the context length Ollama reports for the loaded model (ollama ps) and check that it covers the prompt.
